info.title: Travel App API
info.description: API of the Travel App (working name). Source of truth for the app's generated types.

get.summary: Public keys of our access tokens (for PowerSync)
Name, version and environment of the running API

post.summary: Email sign-up, step 1: checks the password and sends a 6-digit code to the email
Email sign-up, step 2: code from the email; creates the account and trusts this phone
Email + password. Returns a session, or codeRequired on a phone that is not trusted yet
Code from the new-phone email; logs in and trusts this phone for 1 year
Google ID token; logs in or creates the account
Apple ID token; logs in or creates the account
Sends a new code for a sign-up or new-phone login (1 per minute, 5 per hour)
Sends a reset code when the account exists (same answer when it does not)
Code + new password. Ends all sessions; log in again afterwards
Exchanges the refresh token for a new access and refresh token
Ends this phone's session

get.summary: The logged-in user

post.summary: Profile setup: first name, countries, home currency (and consents for Google/Apple users). Also used to edit the profile
Delete my account: body {confirm: "DELETE"}. Ends every session now; everything is erased after 30 days unless restored
Undo "Delete my account" during the 30 days (log in first)

get.summary: Download my data: everything the server keeps about you, as JSON (GDPR right of access). 5 per hour
Your trips with their stops and flights (deleted ones left out), one page at a time
get.description: Up to `limit` trips (default 50, max 100). When `nextCursor` is set, call again with `after=<nextCursor>` for the next page.

get.summary: The places of one of your trips (deleted ones left out), by planned day, "any day" last
The expenses of one of your trips (deleted ones and other people's personal ones left out), newest first
The photos of one of your trips (deleted ones left out), newest first by taken time, else by added time

put.summary: Upload the full photo (image/jpeg, up to 15 MB) of a record that is already synced. Metadata (EXIF, GPS) is removed before storing

get.summary: The full photo as image/jpeg

put.summary: Upload the thumbnail (image/jpeg, up to 1 MB) of a record that is already synced. Metadata is removed before storing

get.summary: The thumbnail as image/jpeg

post.summary: Saves the phone's waiting changes (create, change, delete), one result per change
post.description: Each change is applied column by column; the change that reaches the server last wins (S4). A rejected change comes back with status "rejected" and the reasons; the others are still saved. The answer is 200 whenever the request itself is valid, so the phone never retries a rejected change forever.

get.summary: Weather per day for a place: forecast up to 15 days ahead, after that the typical weather of the last 3 years

Units of each currency for 1 euro, per day. dates and currencies are comma-separated lists (e.g. dates=2026-11-10,2026-11-11&currencies=MAD,ALL). Days without their own rates get the closest earlier day, marked not final
Find places by name or address, nearby ones first when a position is sent
What is at a point on the map: name, address, city and country
Settings for every phone: minimum app version, photo limits, feature switches. Keep the last copy for offline use

post.summary: Back office login, step 1: email + password. Then the code from the authenticator app (or its setup)
Back office login, step 2: the 6-digit code. Returns a 30-minute back office token

get.summary: You: id, email and role
Account counts, sign-ups per day and content totals

get.summary: Find accounts by id or part of the email; emails are masked. 25 per page, newest first
One account: status, consents, counts and trips (no names or places). Audited

Lift a suspension
